  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.</span></h2><p style="text-indent:4.173%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.173%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On October 19, 2026 (the &#8220;Closing Date&#8221;), First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) closed its previously announced private placement (the &#8220;Private Placement&#8221;) of an aggregate 6,106,870 shares (the &#8220;Shares&#8221;) of the Company&#8217;s common stock, par value $0.001 per share. At the closing of the Private Placement, the Company entered into a registration rights agreement (the &#8220;Registration Rights Agreement&#8221;) with the investors in the Private Placement (the &#8220;Investors&#8221;). Pursuant to the Registration Rights Agreement, the Company is required to file or confidentially submit a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) covering the resale by the Investors of the Shares as promptly as reasonably practicable, and in any event no later than 30 days following the Closing Date.</span></p><p
